_meta.warning: expected_classification / expected_calculations in every case are ENGINEERING-DERIVED — traced directly from the current production code (MadhhabRuleEvaluator, lib/features/cycle_tracking/domain/services/madhhab_rule_evaluator.dart). They are NOT a claim of religious correctness. Every case's review_status is NOT_REVIEWED until a qualified scholar/domain reviewer confirms it. cases.expected_user_explanation: Within Hanafi's 3-10 day haid range, prior purity exceeds the 15-day minimum.
Exactly at Hanafi's 72-hour (3-day) minimum — classified as haid, not below it.
One minute short of Hanafi's minimum — does not qualify as haid; requires further guidance rather than a default classification.
Exactly at Shafi'i's 15-day maximum — still classified as haid.
One minute past Shafi'i's 15-day maximum — exceeds the boundary; the engine does not classify this as a distinct istihada state (see FIQH-6), only as needsAdvisory.
Not enough logged history to establish a baseline — the engine does not attempt a classification.

Within Maliki's general 1-15 day range and thus classified haid by this engine's current logic; the engine separately reports the bleeding exceeded her previously-established 6-day personal habit (isWithinPersonalHabit=false) as informational context, not as a factor changing the classification itself.
Hanafi-specific rule: prior purity is one minute short of the 15-day minimum required before a new haid can be confirmed, even though the bleeding duration itself is otherwise valid.
No current bleeding recorded — classified as a state of purity (tuhr).

The identical raw bleeding episode (30 hours, same start date) produces a different classification depending solely on the user's selected madhhab — demonstrating the engine's madhhab-sensitivity is real and reachable, and that raw facts never change, only the applied rule does.

inputs.note: Nifas is NOT handled by MadhhabRuleEvaluator/FiqhCycleState at all — it is computed by a structurally separate engine (PregnancyStatusEngine, feeding FiqhReportInsights.nifas). This case documents that separation rather than exercising MadhhabRuleEvaluator.

cases.expected_user_explanation: Postpartum/nifas status is derived from pregnancy_profile's is_postpartum/postpartum_start_date fields via a separate state machine, prioritized ahead of cycle-state logic in the Fiqh Report. This case is recorded to make the architectural boundary explicit for reviewers, not to exercise a specific numeric threshold.

Deliberately constructed to fail on two independent grounds at once (bleeding duration below minimum AND prior purity below minimum) — engine still correctly resolves to a single needsAdvisory state rather than a contradictory or undefined result; it does not report which of the two grounds triggered it, only that advisory guidance is needed.
